events.title: EUR HAUS
events.description:
EUR HAUS returns to the neon DJ booth you know and love Saturday 11.07.26 & YOU ARE INVITED. 

Kicking off November at Temple Bar with support from Detroit locals MJBleezie & Joseph Fakih. The night kicks off at 9, make it out early and beat the traffic! 

Disco & Afro House grooves to keep you moving from start to finish. 

Come hydrated: we're going to be sweating on the dancefloor. 

Temple Bar - @templebardetroit 
November 7th
9pm - 2am 
$5 at the door 

#detroit #dj #housemusic #disco #templebar
